_comment: Watchdog member list. One entry per member the watchdog should keep alive. 'start' is the command used when that member is not listening (first item = executable, rest = arguments). Each member must have exactly ONE owner here - two entries for the same id fight each other, and the board then shows a member that is 'online' but answers nothing (tools/channel-lock.mjs now enforces this at runtime). NOTE: all members run through the persistent app-server channel (start-channel.cmd) because a cold codex exec per turn takes 5-6 minutes while the app-server takes about 1 minute.

members.why: 常驻 app-server 通道（必须经 cmd 启动：自启动链直接 spawn codex.exe 会 ENOENT）
常驻 app-server 通道：一轮约 1 分钟，取代 5-6 分钟的 codex exec 冷启动
常驻 app-server 通道：取代它自带 watcher 的吞点名行为，也取代 codex exec 冷启动
